description.value: Block One is the signature restaurant at 50th Parallel Estate Winery in Lake Country, named after the estate's first vineyard block planted in 2009. The outdoor dining area is sheltered beneath an award-winning cantilevered structure and centres on a wood-fired forno stage framed by black granite and knotty alder barnboard. A new Granite Room offers an intimate five-course chef's tasting experience for up to six guests, with each dish paired to the estate's own internationally awarded wines.

address.value: 17101 Terrace View Road, Lake Country, BC V4V 1B7
